description: This PHP source file defines the 'StudioBrowser' class, responsible for managing modules within the SuiteCRM module builder. It includes functions for loading modules, loading relatable modules, and retrieving module nodes, with related module factory and user permission logic.

classes.name: StudioBrowser
classes.description: A class for managing and retrieving module information within the SuiteCRM module builder environment.

methods.name: loadModules
methods.description: Loads modules from the 'modules' directory that are accessible to the current user.

methods.name: loadRelatableModules
methods.description: Loads modules that are relatable, similar to loadModules but with less access filtering.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Aggregates and returns module nodes after loading modules.
